session.input: Pixel inspection of preserved production-script screenshots, followed by source audit

observations.label: MEASURED
observations.title: Open shell displaces Instagram as the primary surface
observations.context: Profile, queue-ready, and message states at 1440x900
observations.action: Open the production Field Desk overlay
observations.expectation: Instagram remains the dominant context and the utility reveals only the next safe step
observations.actual: The fixed 462px panel plus 104px black rail occupies about 32 percent of viewport width and covers the right side of the Instagram fixture
observations.playerConsequence: The operator must mentally switch into a second dashboard and loses native context while reviewing an exact target
reproduction: Load the deterministic fixture at 1440x900 with production content scripts
Open the sidecar on profile, queue, or message state
Compare the panel bounds with the native profile control or message row
hypotheses: A 336-380px shell with a compact tab bar or icon rail will preserve native context without removing capabilities
observations.nextDiscriminatingTest: Render both required compact concepts on the same fixture and measure panel-to-viewport area plus target overlap
observations.recommendedOutcome: Default collapsed; use a 380px standard panel capped to viewport and enter an explicit non-overlap execution mode

observations.label: OBSERVED
observations.title: Black rail and acid accent win the first fixation
observations.action: Scan the combined Instagram and overlay frame for the first three seconds
observations.expectation: The current Instagram identity and one safe next action win attention
observations.actual: The full-height near-black rail, lime brand wordmark, lime active rule, and lime action controls out-rank the target username and native Instagram controls
observations.playerConsequence: State hierarchy flattens and ordinary read-only states feel urgent even when nothing needs attention
reproduction: Observe the first high-contrast silhouette before reading labels
hypotheses: Neutral Instagram-adaptive surfaces with lime restricted to state indicators will restore useful hierarchy
observations.nextDiscriminatingTest: Compare grayscale and color-isolation captures for both concepts
observations.recommendedOutcome: Use one neutral shell and reserve brand accent for ready, armed, and safe-stop state marks

observations.label: OBSERVED
observations.title: Queue safety detail competes with the current reviewed item
observations.action: Open Queue with one ready follow item
observations.expectation: The exact username, protection state, and one next action are immediately scannable
observations.actual: Import/export controls, item metadata, three queue controls, a large live-gate card, protocol prose, and signed-run history share one scrolling column
observations.playerConsequence: The operator must parse protocol detail before confirming what account is current and what action is safe
reproduction: Scan from the view title to the first below-fold content
hypotheses: A single target card plus collapsed live-gate and run-history disclosures will preserve every explanation while reducing default load
observations.nextDiscriminatingTest: Time a cold scan to identify target, state, and next action in each concept
observations.recommendedOutcome: Make the current item focal; move import/export, protocol detail, and history behind labeled disclosures

observations.label: OBSERVED
observations.title: Messages makes the locked destructive gate more prominent than evidence
observations.context: Message thread with exact source fixture available but no reviewed intent
observations.action: Open Messages before reading the thread
observations.expectation: Visible read-only evidence and its confidence lead; destructive controls stay secondary until relevant
observations.actual: A large warning block, read/download toolbar, count band, and full live-gate explanation consume the panel while the message evidence area remains empty and the gate clips below the fold
observations.playerConsequence: The screen communicates danger and protocol before it communicates what was actually observed
reproduction: Compare the visible evidence area with the locked gate footprint
hypotheses: A compact thread-like evidence list and conditional gate disclosure will align hierarchy with the safe read-first workflow
observations.nextDiscriminatingTest: Render evidence-only and exact-target-ready states with the gate collapsed and expanded
observations.recommendedOutcome: Lead with evidence identity and one read action; reveal exact-identity detail and the live gate only when relevant

observations.label: OBSERVED
observations.title: Collapsed launcher is simultaneously loud and hard to decode
observations.context: Collapsed first-layer utility at the bottom-right safe inset
observations.action: Collapse the sidecar and return attention to Instagram
observations.expectation: A compact, unmistakable utility control remains discoverable without advertising itself
observations.actual: The clipped acid block shows AIO and FIELD DESK in a small 62px industrial tile with a hard offset shadow; it reads as a badge or ad before it reads as an expandable tool
observations.playerConsequence: Returning operators may miss the affordance while the bright block still competes with native controls
reproduction: Inspect the bottom-right control without prior product knowledge
Compare its shape and contrast with Instagram controls
hypotheses: A 42-44px neutral icon button with an optional state dot will be clearer and quieter
observations.nextDiscriminatingTest: Check focus, contrast, hit target, and recognizability in light/dark fixture captures
observations.recommendedOutcome: Use a neutral 44px launcher with an inline SVG mark, descriptive accessible name, and state-only accent

observations.label: MEASURED
observations.title: Responsive, theme, navigation, and lifecycle contracts are incomplete
observations.action: Audit shell CSS, initialization, navigation semantics, and route lifecycle
observations.expectation: The injected utility adapts to Instagram theme and viewport, exposes correct navigation semantics, and remains idle without polling
observations.actual: The source forces light color scheme, defaults desktop open, has a 520px minimum height, uses aria-selected without tab roles, takes over the full mobile viewport, and polls location every 1.5 seconds without teardown
observations.playerConsequence: Dark mode, short height, zoom, keyboard navigation, and long-lived SPA sessions cannot yet meet the acceptance contract
reproduction: Inspect extension/instagram-overlay.js shell CSS and initialize()
Inspect the recurring setInterval route check
hypotheses: Versioned preferences, semantic tabs, adaptive tokens, bottom-sheet mobile layout, and event-driven route observation close the combined contract
observations.nextDiscriminatingTest: Implement direct runtime tests for preference migration, tabs, theme changes, route teardown, zoom containment, and idle observer behavior
observations.recommendedOutcome: Treat these as release gates in the modular overlay architecture rather than cosmetic follow-ups
